• **Revenue growth trajectory** - Minimum consolidated revenue requirements increase from $265.6M (Q1 2021) to $338.3M (Q4 2021), indicating strong projected growth

• **Established banking relationships** - Fifth amendment indicates ongoing lender support and willingness to modify terms
• **Multiple lender syndicate** - Diversified lender base including Silicon Valley Bank and institutional investors reduces concentration risk
• **Built-in growth floors** - Future covenant levels tied to greater of prior year actual performance or 105% of prior year thresholds

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Tightening covenant structure** - Amendment specifically modifies financial covenants, potentially indicating previous covenant stress
• **Revenue concentration risk** - Separate tracking of Non-PuraPly revenue suggests significant dependence on PuraPly product line
• **Aggressive growth assumptions** - 27.4% increase in minimum revenue requirements from Q1 to Q4 2021 creates execution risk
• **Lender discretion on future covenants** - Post-2021 covenant levels subject to Required Lenders' "reasonable discretion"
• **Multiple amendments** - This is the fifth amendment since March 2019, suggesting ongoing need for covenant modifications
